abstract: A large literature documents that many households underinvest in equities, but the beliefs underlying this behavior remain poorly understood. We study Americans' cynicism toward public companies as a belief structure that helps explain limited market participation, examining its prevalence, underlying mechanisms, and strategies to attenuate it. In a nationally representative survey, we find that corporate cynicism is widespread and negatively predicts individuals’ propensity to invest in stocks. Building on these findings, we conduct a series of experiments and provide causal evidence that corporate cynicism reduces stock investments. We further show that perceiving companies as profit-maximizing fuels corporate cynicism, and that cynicism can be reduced by reshaping beliefs about profit maximization or profit itself. Specifically, cynicism declines when companies highlight broader stakeholder responsibilities in narrative disclosures, when people are prompted to take an investor perspective, and when financial media focus on how corporate profits benefit most Americans versus deepen inequality.
abstract_zh: 大量文献记载了许多家庭在股票投资上投入不足，但支撑这一行为的信念仍鲜为人知。我们研究美国人对上市公司的犬儒主义作为一种信念结构，这有助于解释有限的市场参与，考察其普遍性、内在机制及缓解策略。在一项具有全国代表性的调查中，我们发现企业犬儒主义普遍存在，并且负向预测个人投资股票的倾向。基于这些发现，我们进行了一系列实验，提供了企业犬儒主义减少股票投资的因果证据。我们进一步表明，将公司视为追求利润最大化的认知加剧了企业犬儒主义，而通过重塑关于利润最大化或利润本身的信念可以降低犬儒主义。具体而言，当公司在叙述性披露中强调更广泛的利益相关者责任、当人们被引导采取投资者视角，以及当财经媒体聚焦于企业利润如何惠及大多数美国人而非加深不平等时，犬儒主义会有所下降。
source_issue: Journal of Accounting and Economics, Volume 82, Issue 1
title: Profit-fueled corporate cynicism
title_zh: 逐利驱动的企业犬儒主义

abstract: Using linked Census Tree records and archival sources, I explore the roles of race and gender in migrant selection and sorting during the exodus of single young women and men from U.S. Southern farms from 1900–1940. Female migration rates, influenced by changes in farm men’s marriageability, rose during the farm crisis of 1920–1940 and exceeded men’s by 1940. On- and off-farm discrimination by race and gender drove differences in migrant characteristics: out-of-South Black female migrants, but not within-South, were positively selected on education and family resources, while White women were positively selected across both destinations.
abstract_zh: 利用关联的人口普查树记录与档案资料，本文探究了1900-1940年间美国南部农场单身青年男女外迁过程中，种族与性别在移民选择与分类中的作用。受农场男性婚姻适龄性变化影响，女性迁移率在1920-1940年农业危机期间上升，并于1940年超过男性。种族与性别在农场内外遭遇的歧视导致移民特征差异：迁出南部的黑人女性移民（而非南部内部迁移者）在教育程度与家庭资源方面呈现正向选择，而白人女性在两个迁移目的地均呈现正向选择。
title: Gender and Racial Differences in Migration Behavior: Evidence from the Farm Exodus within and out of the U.S. South, 1900–1940
title_zh: 迁移行为中的性别与种族差异：来自1900–1940年美国南部农业人口外迁的证据

abstract: Using a new database of European academics, we build a network of universities that is based on professors’ mobility. We describe how the network was altered following the Protestant Reformation. We focus on fragmentation and on universities’ centrality. Dyadic regressions confirm that geography and vernacular languages were important for mobility, but did not substitute for religion. We compare simulated networks with and without religious identity. Most universities lose centrality in the simulated religious network compared to the non-religious one. As publications per university are correlated with centrality, the loss of connectedness of many universities after the Reformation contributed to their scientific decline.
abstract_zh: 基于欧洲学者新数据库，我们构建了以教授流动为基础的大学网络，并描述了宗教改革后该网络的变化。研究聚焦于网络碎片化与大学中心性。二元回归分析证实，地理因素与地方语言对学者流动具有重要影响，但并未取代宗教的作用。通过对比含宗教身份与不含宗教身份的模拟网络，发现多数大学在含宗教身份的模拟网络中中心性低于不含宗教身份的网络。由于大学论文发表数量与中心性相关，宗教改革后众多大学连通性的下降导致了其科学地位的衰落。
title: Winners and Losers from the Protestant Reformation: An Analysis of the Network of European Universities
title_zh: 宗教改革的赢家与输家：欧洲大学网络分析

abstract: Between 1910 and 1940, U.S. high school graduation rates rose five-fold, driving twentieth-century economic growth. I explore how the Great Depression’s surge in youth unemployment influenced this trend, emphasizing gender and socioeconomic disparities. Using linked census data and newly digitized city-level unemployment rates, I find that youth unemployment significantly increased high school and post-secondary completion among higher-income boys, while effects on girls and lower-income youths were negligible. These results underscore the role of household resources in leveraging educational opportunities, as financial constraints limited disadvantaged groups from benefiting from reduced opportunity costs.
abstract_zh: 1910年至1940年间，美国高中毕业率增长了五倍，推动了20世纪的经济增长。本文探讨了大萧条期间青年失业率激增如何影响这一趋势，重点关注性别和社会经济差异。通过使用关联人口普查数据和新数字化的城市级失业率数据，我发现青年失业显著提高了高收入男孩的高中和高等教育完成率，而对女孩和低收入青年的影响微乎其微。这些结果凸显了家庭资源在利用教育机会中的作用，因为经济限制使弱势群体难以从机会成本降低中获益。
title: Crises and Educational Attainment
title_zh: 危机与教育成就

abstract: Social decision schemes (SDSs) map the voters’ preferences over multiple alternatives to a probability distribution over these alternatives. In a seminal result, Gibbard (Econometrica 45(3):665–681, 1977) has characterized the set of SDSs that are strategyproof with respect to all utility functions and his result implies that all such SDSs are either unfair to the voters or alternatives, or they require a significant amount of randomization. To circumvent this negative result, we propose the notion of U -strategyproofness which postulates that only voters with a utility function in a predefined set U cannot manipulate. We then analyze the tradeoff between U -strategyproofness and various decisiveness notions that restrict the amount of randomization of SDSs. In particular, we show that if the utility functions in the set U value the best alternative much more than other alternatives, there are U -strategyproof SDSs that choose an alternative with probability 1 whenever all but k voters rank it first. On the negative side, we demonstrate that U -strategyproofness is incompatible with Condorcet-consistency if the set U satisfies minimal symmetry conditions. Finally, we show that no ex post efficient and U -strategyproof SDS can be significantly more decisive than the uniform random dictatorship if the voters are close to indifferent between their two favorite alternatives. abstract_zh: 社会决策方案（SDSs）将选民对多个备选方案的偏好映射为这些备选方案上的概率分布。在开创性成果中，Gibbard（Econometrica 45(3):665–681, 1977）刻画了所有效用函数下均满足策略防护性的SDS集合，其结论表明此类SDS要么对选民或备选方案不公，要么需要大量随机化。为规避这一负面结论，我们提出U-策略防护性概念，该概念仅要求具有预设集合U中效用函数的选民无法操纵。进而分析U-策略防护性与限制SDS随机化程度的各种决定性概念之间的权衡关系。特别地，我们证明：若集合U中的效用函数对最优备选方案的估值远高于其他方案，则存在U-策略防护性SDS，当除k名选民外的所有选民均将某方案列为首选时，该方案以概率1被选中。在负面结论方面，我们证明当集合U满足最小对称性条件时，U-策略防护性与孔多塞一致性不可兼容。最后，我们证明若选民对其最偏好的两个备选方案近乎无差异，则不存在比均匀随机独裁更具显著决定性的事后有效且U-策略防护性SDS。
title: Strategyproof randomized social choice for restricted sets of utility functions
title_zh: 受限效用函数集合上的防策略随机社会选择

abstract: Network connections, both across and within markets, are central in countless economic contexts. In recent decades, a large literature has developed and applied flexible methods for measuring network connectedness and its evolution, based on variance decompositions from vector autoregressions (VARs), as in Diebold and Yilmaz (2014). Those VARs are, however, typically identified using full orthogonalization (Sims, 1980), or no orthogonalization (Koop et al., 1996; Pesaran and Shin, 1998), which, although useful, are special and extreme cases of a more general framework that we develop in this paper. In particular, we allow network nodes to be connected in “clusters”, such as asset classes, industries, regions, etc., where shocks are orthogonal across clusters (Sims style orthogonalized identification) but correlated within clusters (Koop-Pesaran-Potter-Shin style generalized identification), so that the ordering of network nodes is relevant across clusters but irrelevant within clusters. After developing the clustered connectedness framework, we apply it in a detailed empirical exploration of sixteen country equity markets spanning three global regions.
title: Clustered network connectedness: A new measurement framework with application to global equity markets
title_zh: 聚类网络关联性：一种新的测度框架及其在全球股票市场中的应用

abstract: The city of Dundee was renowned for its dominance in the production of jute, a coarse hard waring textile, being responsible for more than 90% of total UK output. As with other industries of the first Industrial Revolution, the industry went into decline in the twentieth century. In Dundee's case, jute production ended in 1999. This book explores the rise of the jute industry in the city of Dundee, from the initial textile stages of flax and linen in the eighteenth century into the dominance of jute from the mid-nineteenth century through to its zenith during the First World War. As such, it provides a valuable adjunct to a range of focused social and economic business histories of the jute industry and the city of Dundee. The book takes a historical approach beginning with the rise of Dundee as a co-ordinating centre for regional out-working, growing due to its existing linen export trade with England, in the decades following the Act of Union in 1707. A specialization upon coarse, rather than fine, linen fabrics encouraged the subsequent development of exporting into the Americas, providing clothing for enslaved persons, and would eventually lead to the movement into other coarse textile products made from jute. This contrasted with centres of fine linen production on the west coast of both Scotland and England where cotton textiles would then emerge. Arguably the most important thesis explored in the following chapter is the identification of the origins of the pre-eminence of Dundee with jute through colonial control of India, and specifically, the linkages between Scottish technical engineers, overseers, and managers positioned in the East India Company. The rise of British textile industries’ links with enslavement and empire provide a more central role in this history, extending our knowledge beyond cotton, first to linen and the provision of textiles during enslavement and then into jute with colonial control of India. As the authors note, ‘it is noticeable how many of the scions of Dundee's merchant families found employment in India, thereby creating a direct channel of communication between Dundee and the Far East’ (p. 75). Chapters 3 and 4 examine the fitful start of early internalization of production in the factory system alongside the ‘chaos’ of rapid urbanization. Fortunes were made and lost by entrepreneurs in an industry in which the price and quality of the raw material could fluctuate significantly. A workforce of agricultural workers and migration from Ireland proved the supply of labour in what was rapidly transforming Dundee from a regional centre into a large city. Between 1755 and 1841 Dundee's population grew from 12,477 to 62,873 and further increased to 153,587 by 1891 (table 4.1, p. 134). As with other textiles, Dundee rapidly became identified with women and child labour, earning the city the moniker as a ‘women's town’. Technical innovation in spinning and weaving facilitated improvements in the consistency of output, and new markets in carpet backing evidence an early diversity of markets for jute products. However, it was the periodic wars of the late nineteenth century and the First World War that created the huge boom in demand. Chapter 5 examines the process of rapid industrialization in the city. The failure of the city's leaders to redevelop ‘New Towns’, as occurred in Edinburgh, left a legacy of some of the worst overcrowding in housing, poor sanitation, and ill health in Scotland. Alongside this, alcoholism, prostitution, and child neglect resulted in women workers in the jute industry being particularly vilified for these social problems. Periodic unemployment, due to fluctuating economic conditions in these early decades of jute's predominance, also provided fertile ground for anti-Irish sectarianism, albeit less prevalent than on the west coast. Chapter 6 focuses upon the rise of Indian competition in global markets for jute products, notably in the low-value areas of bags, sacks, and wrappings for agricultural goods. Dundee and British machine manufacturers provided the capital equipment for the establishment of Indian mills, whilst large fortunes could be made from passive British investors in the managing agencies established to run these mills. In contrast, Dundee's jute owners themselves diverted profits to finance capital investment within the United States through the creation of investment trusts, rather than investing in the jute industry itself. The final two chapters take the story from the last quarter of the nineteenth century to the end of the First World War. Whilst the growth of the industry slowed from the rapid expansion of mid-century, absolute output continued to grow. The industry became concentrated in the hands of a few inter-connected families. The wealth generated in the city led to the opening of its own stock exchange in 1879 (p. 218). However, increasing polarization with a working class developing its own agency through trade unionism, campaigns over food availability and prices, rent strikes, and political representation are all evident. Whilst Whatley and Tomlinson reject the notion that the city was ‘on the brink of revolution’ (p. 214), it certainly became sharply divided along class lines. There are, however, some weaknesses and challenges to the narrative contained in the book. Whatley and Tomlinson are to be commended on their emphasis upon positioning Dundee's rise in the wider post-colonial historical understanding of enslavement, empire, and imperialism. Whilst they do not reject earlier historiographies highlighting Dundee's links to the whaling industry and earlier textiles, first enslavement and then empire are prioritized. However, this sits somewhat at odds with the description of the relationship between Dundee and India as ‘symbiotic’ (p. 73). No matter how low wages were driven in Dundee they were never low enough to compete with Calcutta (modern day Kolkata) on labour costs. These were far from symbiotic features of the industry, but rather a divide which pitted workers in Dundee and Kolkata against one another to the benefit of employers in both centres. One area missing from the discussion is that of employers’ management of competition and eventual cartelization within the industry. Whilst the Chamber of Commerce is highlighted as important in this area as well as the co-ordination undertaken over wage levels, the book is silent on the employers’ trade associations that emerged by the end of the period, notably the Association of Jute Spinners and Manufacturers, formally launched in 1918 after the period of consolidation and concentration between the small number of families from the 1880s onwards (p. 216). The book is in many ways a book in two halves. The first three longer chapters examining the period to the end of the nineteenth century extensively examines the rise of jute. This is very much focused upon the named entrepreneurs as individuals who constructed the city's history, and is therefore a very traditional history from above, whereas the following four chapters, in many ways more interesting, cover the social and political impact of industrialization on the city with a greater focus from below. Rapid urbanization and slum housing, moral panic arising from women as the dominant component in the industry workforce ‘neglecting’ the double burden of employment and responsibility for the household, poverty, and the rise of working-class politics form the subjects of these shorter chapters. More could have been explored in this part of the book, for this reader at least. In conclusion, the book provides an important and valuable summary of the existing literature and adds new insights into the linkages between economic, social, and political developments which made and remade Dundee as a city over two centuries.
abstract_zh: 邓迪市以生产黄麻而闻名，这是一种粗糙耐磨的纺织品，其产量占英国总产量的90%以上。与第一次工业革命中的其他行业一样，该行业在二十世纪走向衰退。就邓迪而言，黄麻生产于1999年终止。本书探讨了邓迪市黄麻产业的兴起过程，从十八世纪亚麻和亚麻布的初步纺织阶段，到十九世纪中叶黄麻的主导地位，直至第一次世界大战期间的鼎盛时期。因此，它为一系列关于黄麻产业和邓迪市的专题社会与经济商业史提供了宝贵的补充。本书采用历史研究方法，从邓迪作为区域外加工协调中心的崛起开始，这一崛起得益于其与英格兰现有的亚麻出口贸易，在1707年《联合法案》之后的几十年间得以发展。专注于粗麻布而非细麻布的生产，促进了向美洲出口的进一步发展，为被奴役者提供衣物，并最终引导产业转向由黄麻制成的其他粗纺织品。这与苏格兰和英格兰西海岸的细麻布生产中心形成对比，后者随后兴起了棉纺织品。可以说，下一章探讨的最重要论点是，通过殖民控制印度，识别出邓迪在黄麻产业中卓越地位的起源，特别是苏格兰技术工程师、监工和管理人员在东印度公司中的联系。英国纺织业与奴隶制和帝国的联系在这一历史中扮演了更为核心的角色，将我们的知识从棉花扩展到亚麻，再到奴隶制期间纺织品的供应，最后延伸到通过殖民控制印度而发展起来的黄麻产业。正如作者所指出的，“值得注意的是，邓迪商人家庭的许多后裔在印度找到了工作，从而在邓迪与远东之间建立了直接的沟通渠道”（第75页）。第三章和第四章考察了工厂制度下早期生产内部化的不稳定开端，以及快速城市化带来的“混乱”。在这个原材料价格和质量可能大幅波动的行业中，企业家们既创造了财富也遭受了损失。农业工人和来自爱尔兰的移民劳动力供应，使邓迪迅速从区域中心转变为大城市。1755年至1841年间，邓迪的人口从12,477人增长到62,873人，到1891年进一步增至153,587人（表4.1，第134页）。与其他纺织业一样，邓迪迅速与女性和童工联系在一起，赢得了“女性之城”的绰号。纺纱和织造方面的技术创新提高了产出的一致性，地毯底布等新市场则显示了黄麻产品早期市场的多样性。然而，正是十九世纪末的周期性战争和第一次世界大战创造了巨大的需求繁荣。第五章考察了该市快速工业化的过程。该市领导人未能像爱丁堡那样进行“新城”再开发，留下了苏格兰最严重的住房过度拥挤、卫生条件差和健康问题的不良遗产。与此同时，酗酒、卖淫和忽视儿童等问题导致黄麻产业中的女性工人因这些社会问题而受到特别指责。在黄麻主导地位的早期几十年中，由于经济状况波动导致的周期性失业，也为反爱尔兰宗派主义提供了土壤，尽管其程度不如西海岸严重。第六章聚焦于印度在全球黄麻产品市场上的竞争崛起，尤其是在袋、麻袋和农产品包装等低价值领域。邓迪和英国的机器制造商为印度工厂的建立提供了资本设备，而通过管理这些工厂的代理机构，被动的英国投资者可以赚取巨额财富。相比之下，邓迪的黄麻所有者则将利润转向通过创建投资信托在美国进行资本投资，而不是投资于黄麻产业本身。最后两章将故事从十九世纪最后二十五年延续到第一次世界大战结束。尽管产业增长从世纪中叶的快速扩张中放缓，但绝对产量仍在继续增长。该产业集中在少数相互关联的家族手中。该市创造的财富促使其于1879年开设了自己的证券交易所（第218页）。然而，日益加剧的两极分化，工人阶级通过工会运动、关于食品供应和价格的运动、租金罢工以及政治代表权发展出自己的能动性，这些都显而易见。尽管沃特利和汤姆林森拒绝接受该市“处于革命边缘”的观点（第214页），但它确实在阶级界限上变得尖锐分裂。然而，本书的叙述也存在一些弱点和挑战。沃特利和汤姆林森强调将邓迪的崛起置于更广泛的后殖民历史理解中，涉及奴隶制、帝国和帝国主义，这一点值得称赞。虽然他们没有拒绝早期史学强调邓迪与捕鲸业和早期纺织业的联系，但首先优先考虑了奴隶制，然后是帝国。然而，这与将邓迪与印度之间的关系描述为“共生”（第73页）有些矛盾。无论邓迪的工资被压得多低，它们都永远无法在劳动力成本上与加尔各答（现代加尔各答）竞争。这些远非该产业的共生特征，而是一种分裂，使邓迪和加尔各答的工人相互对立，从而有利于两地的雇主。讨论中缺失的一个领域是雇主对竞争的管理以及最终行业内的卡特尔化。虽然商会在这方面以及工资水平的协调中被强调为重要，但本书对这一时期末出现的雇主行业协会保持沉默，特别是黄麻纺纱和制造商协会，该协会于1918年正式成立，此前自1880年代以来少数家族之间进行了整合和集中（第216页）。本书在许多方面分为两部分。前三章较长，考察了到十九世纪末的时期，深入探讨了黄麻的兴起。这非常侧重于作为个体构建城市历史的具名企业家，因此是一种非常传统的自上而下的历史，而接下来的四章，在许多方面更有趣，涵盖了工业化对城市的社会和政治影响，更侧重于自下而上的视角。快速城市化和贫民窟住房、因女性作为产业劳动力主导成分“忽视”就业和家庭责任双重负担而引发的道德恐慌、贫困以及工人阶级政治的兴起，构成了这些较短章节的主题。至少对于这位读者而言，本书的这一部分本可以探讨更多内容。总之，本书对现有文献进行了重要而有价值的总结，并为经济、社会和政治发展之间的联系提供了新的见解，这些发展在两个世纪中塑造并重塑了邓迪这座城市。
title: The Triumph of Textiles: Industrial Dundee c. 1700–1918.Christopher A. Whatley and Jim Tomlinson, (Edinburgh University Press, 2024. Pp.291. ISBN: 9781399537827. PbK £19).
title_zh: 纺织业的胜利：工业化的邓迪（约1700–1918年）

abstract: Sheilagh Ogilvie has written another big and important book. It explores a new theme for her: how do societies respond to and tackle epidemics? But she does so through a focus on institutions and a method that, for want of a better term, I think of as critical synthesis, which will be familiar to readers of her earlier work. Here she explores how a set of six institutions – the market, the state, local community, religion, guilds, and the family – have contributed to preventing and limiting epidemics, or alternatively, made them worse over a broad span of time and space, from the mid-fourteenth century to the present.
abstract_zh: 希拉·奥格尔维又撰写了一部宏大而重要的著作。本书探索了一个对她而言的新主题：社会如何应对并处理流行病？然而，她通过聚焦于制度，并采用一种我称之为“批判性综合”的方法（若找不到更恰当的词汇）来展开论述，这一方法对她早期作品的读者来说应当颇为熟悉。在此书中，她探讨了六种制度——市场、国家、地方社区、宗教、行会及家庭——如何在中世纪十四世纪中叶至今的广阔时空范围内，对预防和限制流行病做出贡献，或者相反，使疫情恶化。
title: Controlling Contagion: Epidemics and Institutions from the Black Death to Covid. Sheilagh Ogilvie, (Princeton University Press, 2025. Pp.544. ISBN 9780691255569. HbK £38)
title_zh: 控制传染：从黑死病到新冠的流行病与制度，谢拉格·奥格尔维著（普林斯顿大学出版社，2025年，544页，ISBN 9780691255569，精装本，38英镑）

abstract: Susan Carrruthers has written a splendid book. Picking up on the wartime slogan of ‘Make Do and Mend’, she shows how much more we can understand about Britain in the 1940s by starting with the textiles, clothing, and footwear of the times. These products – perishable, threadbare after years of war, and chronically scarce – were critical to the ‘starting over’ that followed this calamitous conflict. As she argues, material stuff such as clothes and shoes and blankets and bedding were pivotal to the refashioning of relationships within the British Isles, as between Britons and others they encountered both at home and overseas: U.S. troops ‘over here’, British GI brides ‘over there’, service personnel from Britain's colonies, survivors of Nazi camps, and displaced persons and immigrants.
abstract_zh: 苏珊·卡拉瑟斯撰写了一部精彩之作。她借用了战时口号“修修补补，物尽其用”，展示了从当时的纺织品、服装和鞋履入手，我们能对20世纪40年代的英国有更深刻的理解。这些产品——历经战争岁月而磨损破旧、长期稀缺易损——对于这场灾难性冲突后的“重新开始”至关重要。正如她所言，衣物、鞋履、毯子和寝具等物质用品，在不列颠群岛内部人际关系的重塑中起到了关键作用，也影响了英国人与国内外相遇的他者之间的关系：驻扎此地的美军士兵、远在海外的英国新娘、来自英国殖民地的军人、纳粹集中营的幸存者，以及流离失所者和移民。
title: Making Do: Britons and the Refashioning of the Postwar World. Susan Carruthers, (Cambridge University press, 2025. Pp. 400. ISBN 9781009464284. HbK £25).
title_zh: 《将就：英国人与战后世界的重塑》

abstract: Victoria Bateman's Economica is, above all, a great read. It is written for a general audience, and Bateman's gifts as a scholar, writer, and wit are beautifully displayed throughout. Here, she raises the widest of Minervan wings to move confidently across the centuries and the continents. Arguments are conveyed through vivid storytelling, making Economica engaging, enjoyable, pacy, fun, and quite frankly, exciting in many places. Bateman's central contribution is to explode the widely held belief that women's economic liberation was a twentieth-century achievement with its origins in enlightenment and modernity. Academic historians may know that women had economic power at times in history, but beyond the seminar room, many of the educated and successful people running large organizations today may have heard of Claudia Goldin, yet know nothing of the period before 1850 other than the word ‘patriarchy’. Bateman corrects this, telling the stories of women who possessed significant economic roles, wealth, and authority from 500 BC across the globe. In doing so, she offers readers a rethink of some familiar ideas about power, progress, and emancipation. This is a valuable intervention, and one that scholarly economic historians should take seriously, even where they might remain unconvinced by particular claims, approaches, or interpretations. Bateman's grasp of long-run global economic history is impressive and she makes connections that specialists in the field of gender may need reminding of, such as the strong link between an emerging female labour market in late medieval southern Europe and enslavement. As the chapters evolve, a pattern emerges that should be obvious to academic economic historians but is too rarely discussed or analysed. The determinant of how societies have shared economic power and productivity between men and women is a matter fundamentally of property rights. (The recurrent theme of the value of reproduction in creating and maintaining wealth is one that should be of huge interest given current intergenerational inequities). The consistent story is that throughout history, in growing or emerging economies, many women have owned and controlled property, participated in trade and production, and created wealth. However, after a period of growth, women's rights and activities always tend to be eroded rather than expanded. Economica’s narrative suggests that when the distribution of gains from economic activity becomes uncertain – during periods of technological disruption, market expansion, or structural transformation (war) – conservative forces (men and women) emerge to construct institutions that regulate, exclude, and restrict women. Law, custom, professionalization, and moral discourse turn to function as active mechanisms of economic ordering to women's exclusion and ultimately, harm. Academic readers are likely to bristle in places. Bateman's treatment of economic activity can be viewed as conflating wealth, position, agency, leadership, intellectual talent, productivity, scientific knowledge, managerial competence, and entrepreneurialism into a single category of ‘economic power’. Their conflation sometimes weakens the explanatory force of the argument. For specialists, this might be frustrating. Yet casting this off as general interest trade book risks missing a deeper thesis that runs through it. Economica suggests that women's exclusion is not just a legacy of ‘patriarchy’, but a recurring outcome of the process of institutional change that emerge from economic and technological development. If Sheilagh Ogilvie's focus has been on old institutions as exclusionary and discriminatory, the implications of Economica are that it is the new ones we also need to keep an eye on. Although Bateman seeks to make the point that societies should support female economic activity, with a 10-point manifesto for female empowerment at the end, Economica also points beyond itself. The relationship between growth, technological change, and the gendered design of economic institutions remains under-theorized. The similarities or otherwise between the institutions that emerge, whose interests they serve, and how they evolve across cycles of expansion and disruption is work still to be done. Bateman does not resolve these questions, but she places them firmly on the agenda. For that reason, and also because students will probably love it, Economica is a book that economic historians should embrace and probably put on a reading list.
abstract_zh: 维多利亚·贝特曼的《经济学》首先是一部极佳的读物。它面向普通读者撰写，贝特曼作为学者、作家和幽默大师的才华在书中处处闪耀。在此，她展开最宽广的密涅瓦之翼，自信地跨越数个世纪与各大洲。论点通过生动的叙事传达，使《经济学》引人入胜、令人愉悦、节奏明快、妙趣横生，坦率地说，在许多地方令人兴奋不已。贝特曼的核心贡献在于打破了人们广泛持有的信念，即女性的经济解放是二十世纪的成就，其根源在于启蒙与现代性。学术历史学家或许知道女性在历史上某些时期拥有经济权力，但在研讨室之外，当今许多受过教育、经营大型组织的成功人士可能听说过克劳迪娅·戈尔丁，却对1850年之前的时期一无所知，只知“父权制”一词。贝特曼纠正了这一点，讲述了从公元前500年起全球各地拥有重要经济角色、财富和权威的女性的故事。在此过程中，她为读者提供了对权力、进步和解放等一些熟悉观念的重新思考。这是一项有价值的介入，学术经济历史学家应认真对待，即使他们可能对某些具体主张、方法或解释仍持保留态度。贝特曼对长期全球经济史的把握令人印象深刻，她建立了性别领域专家可能需要提醒的联系，例如中世纪晚期南欧新兴女性劳动力市场与奴役之间的紧密关联。随着章节的推进，一种模式浮现出来，这对学术经济历史学家而言应当显而易见，却鲜少被讨论或分析。社会如何在男女之间分配经济权力和生产力的决定因素，从根本上说是产权问题。（关于再生产在创造和维持财富中的价值的反复主题，鉴于当前代际不平等问题，应引起极大关注。）一贯的故事是，纵观历史，在增长或新兴经济体中，许多女性拥有并控制财产，参与贸易和生产，创造财富。然而，在增长一段时间后，女性的权利和活动总是趋于被侵蚀而非扩展。《经济学》的叙事表明，当经济活动收益的分配变得不确定时——在技术颠覆、市场扩张或结构性转型（战争）时期——保守力量（男性和女性）便会涌现，构建起规范、排斥和限制女性的制度。法律、习俗、专业化和道德话语转而成为经济秩序化的积极机制，导致女性的排斥，最终造成伤害。学术读者可能会在某些地方感到不快。贝特曼对经济活动的处理可被视为将财富、地位、能动性、领导力、智力才能、生产力、科学知识、管理能力和企业家精神混为一谈，归入“经济权力”这一单一类别。这种混同有时削弱了论证的解释力。对专家而言，这可能令人沮丧。然而，将其轻视为面向大众的通俗读物，可能会错失贯穿其中的更深层论点。《经济学》表明，女性的排斥不仅是“父权制”的遗产，更是经济和技术发展所催生的制度变迁过程的反复出现的结果。如果希拉·奥格尔维的关注点在于旧制度具有排斥性和歧视性，那么《经济学》的启示则是，我们也需要关注新制度。尽管贝特曼试图论证社会应支持女性的经济活动，并在书末提出了十点女性赋权宣言，《经济学》也指向了自身之外。增长、技术变革与经济制度的性别化设计之间的关系仍未得到充分理论化。所涌现的制度之间的相似性或差异性、它们服务于谁的利益，以及它们如何在扩张与颠覆的周期中演变，仍是待完成的工作。贝特曼并未解决这些问题，但她将它们坚定地提上了议程。正因如此，也因学生们可能会喜爱这本书，《经济学》是一本经济历史学家应当接纳并可能列入阅读书目的著作。
title: Economica: A Global History of Women, Wealth and Power. Victoria Bateman, (Headline Publishing Group, 2025. Pp. 432. ISBN 9781035415779. HbK £25)
title_zh: 《经济学刊：女性、财富与权力的全球史》

abstract: In this book, the authors explore the history of the CEO from 1900 to the present day. Aldous and Turner ask, ‘Who gets to the top job, what they do when they are at the top, what do they earn and are they successful?’ The authors argue that the story of Britain's economic change in the twentieth century is largely narrated from the perspective of politicians and policymakers. This approach omits the hugely influential role of corporate leaders on Britain's economy. This book fills that gap and tells the story of Britain's economy since 1900 through the lens of its corporate leaders. The book is rich in narrative detail and anecdotes, which makes it a highly entertaining read. The authors address the questions on the CEO by assembling a database of the top 100 most valuable UK companies on the London Stock Exchange since 1900. This database comprises 475 companies and 1,397 CEOs and provides the empirical backbone of their analysis. The book develops five central themes that speak to ongoing debates about CEOs. First, how has the role of the CEO changed? This question addresses how the professional manager CEO came to dominate the leadership of the UK's largest firms. Second, how did CEOs’ training and career experiences develop? Interestingly, professional experience in accounting and engineering became more widespread, while those with deep insights into the company and industry were preferred to outsiders. The third thread examines how the scope of the CEO role has been determined by changes in corporate governance regimes. Fourth, the book examines the social mobility and diversity of CEOs. The book observes how aristocrats and social elites rapidly disappeared as the leaders of big business were superseded by professional managers. The final thread looks at the performance of CEOs and the effect they have on their companies and the wider economy. This question is explored in the context of the era and in relation to competitor companies and economies. The book is divided into seven chapters. Chapter 2 takes the reader through the journey of the aristocratic CEO who drove innovations in both business and society. The chapter discusses how British social elites were among 41 per cent of the CEOs who were peers of the realm and dominated corporate leadership roles. Chapter 3 looks at the role of the CEO during the interwar period, where family and founder CEOs were prevalent, and how they were particularly challenged by succession issues. Dynamic founders and family networks cooperated closely with the government to navigate the sea of instability and upheaval of the interwar years, leading to the establishment of the United Kingdom's biggest and most successful companies of the twentieth century. Over time, as company ownership became diffused and diluted through mergers, the influence of families and founders waned in the years after the Second World War. This governance structure was replaced by managing directors at the top of British companies. Chapter 4 explores the post-Second World War era, where Britain's CEOs faced mounting economic challenges. In the midst of rising international competition, there were calls for a managerial revolution to exploit new technologies. Professionals such as engineers and accountants made up an increasing proportion of top CEOs. These trends increased social diversity, with a rising number of CEOs reaching the top positions through merit rather than social position or family. The chapter argues that, while training in accountancy and engineering brought a focus on efficiency, it led to more bureaucratic organizations and siloed thinking. Chapter 5 explores the 1970s, where Britain's economic malaise had become chronic. The chapter explores how a group of outsiders sought to cure the malaise by unleashing market forces, such as a hostile takeover to shake-up poor-quality incumbent management. Chapter 6 examines how CEOs took advantage of structural economic changes during the 1990s, such as privatizations, globalization, and the information and communication technology (ICT) revolution. During the 1990s and 2000s, CEOs became ‘Fat Cats’ and hubristic CEOs who created several corporate failures which greatly damaged Britain's economy. This chapter explores a pertinent question. Did the increased pay of CEOs, especially those of telecommunication companies, correspond with improved corporate performance? The authors argue that tying pay to performance induces short-termism and other behaviours not conducive to shareholders’ interests. The chapter also shows that the Cadbury report sought to rein in CEO excesses, but with limited effect. Chapter 7 explores and argues that those involved in selecting and preparing CEOs need to develop pathways that identify individuals with interpersonal characteristics, values, and vision focused on the long-term stewardship of the company. More importantly, the chapter also argues that the corporate governance framework needs to be strengthened through legislation to align the interests of CEOs with other company stakeholders. A related question concerns the extent to which patterns observed among the largest listed firms can be generalized to the wider British corporate economy. While the focus on elite companies is justified given their economic importance, future work might explore how these dynamics differ in smaller or regionally embedded firms. Finally, why should we care about CEOs? As the authors make clear, CEOs wield substantial economic power and exert significant influence over politics and public policy. Overall, this book offers fresh insights into major questions surrounding British economic development, meritocracy, social mobility, income inequality, and the evolving relationship between business and state.
abstract_zh: 在这本书中，作者们探讨了自1900年至今CEO的历史。阿尔杜斯和特纳提出疑问：“谁能够登上最高职位，他们在高位时做了什么，他们赚取多少，以及他们是否成功？”作者们认为，二十世纪英国经济变革的故事大多是从政治家和政策制定者的视角来叙述的。这种方法忽略了企业领袖对英国经济产生的巨大影响。本书填补了这一空白，通过企业领袖的视角讲述了自1900年以来英国经济的故事。书中充满了丰富的叙事细节和轶事，使其成为一本极具娱乐性的读物。作者们通过汇编自1900年以来伦敦证券交易所上英国最具价值的100家公司的数据库来解答关于CEO的问题。该数据库包含475家公司和1，397位CEO，为他们的分析提供了实证基础。 本书围绕五个核心主题展开，这些主题与当前关于CEO的讨论相呼应。首先，CEO的角色是如何变化的？这一问题探讨了职业经理人CEO是如何主导英国大型企业领导层的。其次，CEO的培训和职业经历是如何发展的？有趣的是，会计和工程领域的专业经验变得更加普遍，而那些对公司及行业有深刻见解的内部人士比外部人士更受青睐。第三个线索考察了CEO职责范围是如何由公司治理制度的变化所决定的。第四，本书审视了CEO的社会流动性和多样性。书中观察到，随着职业经理人取代贵族和社会精英成为大企业的领导者，这些贵族和精英迅速消失。最后一个线索关注CEO的表现及其对公司乃至整个经济的影响。这一问题是在特定时代背景下，并与竞争对手公司和经济体相比较来探讨的。 本书分为七个章节。第二章带领读者了解贵族CEO的历程，他们在商业和社会领域都推动了创新。该章讨论了英国社会精英中，有41%的CEO是贵族阶层成员，他们主导了企业领导角色。第三章考察了两次世界大战期间CEO的角色，那时家族和创始人CEO较为普遍，他们尤其面临继任问题的挑战。充满活力的创始人和家族网络与政府紧密合作，以应对战间期的动荡不安，从而建立了二十世纪英国最大、最成功的公司。随着时间的推移，由于公司所有权通过并购变得分散和稀释，家族和创始人的影响力在二战后逐渐减弱。这种治理结构被英国公司顶层的总经理所取代。第四章探讨了二战后时期，英国CEO面临日益严峻的经济挑战。在国际竞争加剧的背景下，有人呼吁进行管理革命以利用新技术。工程师和会计师等专业人士在顶级CEO中所占比例不断增加。这些趋势增加了社会多样性，越来越多的CEO凭借才能而非社会地位或家族背景达到高层职位。该章认为，虽然会计和工程培训带来了对效率的关注，但也导致了更加官僚化的组织和思维孤岛。第五章探讨了20世纪70年代，当时英国的经济困境已成为慢性问题。该章探讨了一群外部人士如何试图通过释放市场力量来治愈这种困境，例如通过敌意收购来整顿质量低下的现任管理层。第六章考察了CEO如何利用20世纪90年代的结构性经济变革，如私有化、全球化以及信息和通信技术革命。在20世纪90年代和2000年代，CEO变成了“肥猫”，傲慢自大的CEO造成了多次企业失败，严重损害了英国经济。本章探讨了一个相关问题：CEO薪酬的增加，尤其是电信公司的CEO，是否与公司业绩改善相对应？作者们认为，将薪酬与业绩挂钩会导致短期主义和其他不利于股东利益的行为。该章还显示，卡德伯里报告试图限制CEO的过度行为，但效果有限。第七章探讨并主张，那些参与选拔和培养CEO的人需要开发途径，以识别具有人际交往特质、价值观和愿景，专注于公司长期管理的个人。更重要的是，该章还主张通过立法加强公司治理框架，以使CEO的利益与其他公司利益相关者保持一致。 一个相关的问题是，在最大上市公司中观察到的模式在多大程度上可以推广到更广泛的英国企业经济中。虽然鉴于精英公司的重要性而关注它们是合理的，但未来的研究可能会探讨这些动态在较小或区域嵌入的公司中如何不同。最后，为什么我们应该关心CEO？正如作者们所明确指出的，CEO拥有巨大的经济权力，并对政治和公共政策产生重大影响。总体而言，本书为围绕英国经济发展、精英统治、社会流动性、收入不平等以及企业与国家之间不断演变的关系等重大问题提供了新的见解。
title: The CEO: The Rise and Fall of Britain's Captains of Industry Michael Aldous and John Turner, (Cambridge University Press, 2025. Pp. 296. ISBN 9781009489522. Hbk £25).
title_zh: 《CEO：英国工业领袖的兴衰》迈克尔·奥尔德斯、约翰·特纳著（剑桥大学出版社，2025年，296页，ISBN 9781009489522，精装本25英镑）

abstract: Even the most ardent of Marxists would have to admit that the real heavyweight bout of the twentieth century was ultimately won by capitalism. This was not a K.O., exactly – the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics (USSR) under the leadership of M. S. Gorbachev more or less just threw in the towel – but the decision has never been a split one. By all accounts and judgments, socialism never managed to keep up with (or overtake) capitalism as an economic organizing principle. Since the collapse of the USSR in 1991, the debate has thus largely not been about the relative strengths of the two economic systems, but instead about how and why socialism failed to live up to the seeming promise of its postwar boom and initial challenge to global capitalist dominance.
abstract_zh: 即便是最坚定的马克思主义者也不得不承认，二十世纪真正的重量级对决最终由资本主义胜出。这并非一场击倒性胜利——确切地说，苏联在戈尔巴乔夫领导下几乎是主动放弃了——但裁判结果从未有过分歧。无论从哪个角度看，社会主义作为经济组织原则，始终未能跟上（或超越）资本主义的步伐。自1991年苏联解体以来，争论的焦点已不再是两种经济体系的相对优劣，而是社会主义为何及如何未能兑现其战后繁荣及对全球资本主义主导地位初步挑战所展现出的潜力。
title: Book Review Essay: Explaining Soviet Economic Outcomes From the Outside In
title_zh: 书评论文：从外部解释苏联经济结果

abstract: In Raised to Obey, Agustina Paglayan challenges conventional interpretations of the spread of mass education since the late eighteenth century, which have been based – particularly within economic history – on arguments such as increased returns to human capital due to industrialization and growing democratization. Instead, the book defends a political-economy argument according to which elites expanded schooling not primarily to foster growth or equality but to contain social unrest and inculcate obedience among potentially rebellious populations. Mass education emerged as a substitute for repression: an investment in social order that, in the long run, would be less costly and more sustainable than mere coercion – a thesis that, in different forms, has long been debated, not least within economics (Bowles and Gintis 1976). The scope of the book is impressive. Drawing on a wide range of historical and quantitative evidence, Paglayan traces the expansion of primary education across Europe and the Americas from the late eighteenth century onwards, combining cross-country analysis with detailed case studies, such as those of Britain, France, and Chile, among others. Although the argument is not original per se, the core contribution of the book is providing compelling evidence that conflict and elite fear played the most important role in the long-term diffusion of mass education and literacy – at least for Europe and Latin America, questioning the assumption that schooling was designed to empower citizens or enhance productivity. The book is an excellent read for academics and policymakers alike and provides a lot of food for thought concerning historical education and its relationship with society and the economy. Interestingly, the book looks at the history of education to question today's educational practices across countries. Are present-day education systems, which arose from the attempt of nineteenth-century elites to control potentially threatening populations, the best way to really stimulate democratization, free thinking, and the growth of useful knowledge? While this question remains valid, Paglayan's reinterpretation of the historical factors that sustained mass education sits uneasily with parts of the existing scholarly literature. The core argument of the book seems to rest on the implicit assumption that education was mainly a state-level phenomenon and that national education acts passed by the central government exerted an immediate (and homogeneous) impact across all regions and social strata within the same country. Indeed, the most used indicator to capture central governments acting to improve primary education is whether they have passed a national school law. Yet, recent evidence, particularly on countries that are not discussed within the book, such as Italy (Cappelli and Vasta 2020) and Spain (Beltrán Tapia and Martinez-Galarraga 2018), shows that national legislation concerning primary schooling was likely ineffective in fostering education alone, which was primarily due to the way the primary-school system was designed, that is, as primarily decentralized. The government set the rules of the game, but local authorities implemented them (p. 108) – the extent of which depended on local democratization, fiscal and administrative capacity, inequality, and existing schooling rates, among the others. Paglayan's claim that administrative form (centralization versus decentralization) does not matter for her argument (p. 118) is not fully convincing, particularly considering known historical variations across Europe (Westberg 2020). Another broad concern is the treatment of confounding factors in the quantitative sections. For example, changes in the trends of enrolment rates are interpreted as responses to unrest (p. 79), yet alternative explanations – such as economic performance or state capacity – receive more limited attention. Similarly, though wars (external conflict) are mentioned in the book, their potential state-building implications are not fully integrated into the analytical framework. This may be problematic, as warfare has long been central to explanations of the expansion in fiscal capacity (Dincecco et al. 2011; Sabaté 2016). A related issue concerns some of the variables used to capture structural change in phenomena potentially associated with education. Industrialization is measured using broad indicators (p. 66), while the diffusion of education is proxied by the passage of national education legislation – as mentioned earlier. One may argue that these measures do not always capture the underlying phenomena convincingly, particularly given recent work showing the importance of gradual, locally driven schooling expansion (see above), as well as existing estimates of industrial value-added and/or per-capita GDP figures across most of the countries included in the book's analyses. Indeed, one may argue, economic growth might pull the expansion of education through the service sector, too, or even when new technologies are introduced within the primary sector. The book's empirical strategy is more convincing in some contexts than in others. The analysis of Chile, particularly the Atacama rebellion, stands out as a compelling case in which a clear core–periphery conflict aligns well with the theory. By contrast, evidence from Europe would benefit from replication using alternative datasets. Recent work, including Adrien Montalbo's research on nineteenth-century France, suggests that there is more to the expansion of mass education than just a disciplinary channel, including demand for education fostered by industrialization (Montalbo 2020). The discussion of nineteenth-century Britain and, differently, Sweden and France, further illustrates some of these issues and brings about others. Paglayan notes that around 1850 Britain exhibited relatively low enrolment ratios compared with continental Europe (pp. 62–63). Yet, for matters of human capital accumulation, literacy – regardless of how it was acquired – arguably matters more than formal enrolment. On this metric, Britain does not appear particularly backward. England and Wales displayed the highest literacy rates among European regions in the second half of the nineteenth century (Mitch 1984), and gross enrolment rates did not lag much behind those of Central and Northern Europe (Cappelli, Ridolfi, Vasta, and Westberg 2025). The book also tends to interpret curricular differentiation between urban and rural areas as a deliberate strategy to immobilize rural populations (p. 68). While this may be consistent with the core argument of the book, an alternative interpretation is that simplified rural curricula lowered barriers to entry, allowing basic schooling to take root where resources and demand were limited, as it seems to have been the case in nineteenth-century Sweden (Westberg 2022). The French case also exposes some tensions in the core thesis. Paglayan shows how elites oscillated between repression and educational investment in response to rural unrest (p. 139). Yet, early primary education itself involved some forms of coercion, such as compulsory attendance, linguistic standardization, and moral discipline, that may not have been perceived as fundamentally different from other instruments of state power. Moreover, the long and uncertain horizon of educational returns complicates the notion that schooling was a clearly superior alternative to repression from the perspective of national and/or local elites. Raised to Obey is an important and stimulating book. It forces historians and political economists alike to confront uncomfortable questions about the political purposes of schooling and the relationship between education and power – potentially making room for future empirical studies on the matter that adopt a historical perspective. The book succeeds in broadening the debate and in challenging complacent narratives of education as an unambiguous public good. It will be widely read and discussed, and rightly so.
abstract_zh: 在《被培养成服从》一书中，奥古斯蒂娜·帕格莱安挑战了自十八世纪末以来关于大众教育普及的传统解释，这些解释——尤其是在经济史领域——基于诸如工业化带来的人力资本回报增加以及日益增长的民主化等论点。相反，该书捍卫了一种政治经济学论点，即精英阶层扩展教育并非主要为了促进增长或平等，而是为了遏制社会动荡，并在潜在的反叛人群中灌输服从意识。大众教育作为镇压的替代品出现：一种对社会秩序的投资，从长远来看，其成本更低、比单纯的强制手段更具可持续性——这一论点以不同形式长期受到辩论，尤其是在经济学界（鲍尔斯和金蒂斯，1976年）。本书的覆盖面令人印象深刻。借助广泛的历史和定量证据，帕格莱安追溯了自十八世纪末以来欧洲和美洲初等教育的扩展，将跨国分析与详细案例研究相结合，如英国、法国和智利等。尽管这一论点本身并非原创，但本书的核心贡献在于提供了令人信服的证据，表明冲突和精英的恐惧在长期大众教育和识字率的普及中发挥了最重要的作用——至少对欧洲和拉丁美洲而言，从而质疑了教育旨在赋权公民或提高生产力的假设。本书对学者和政策制定者而言都是一本极佳的读物，为历史教育及其与社会经济的关系提供了大量思考素材。有趣的是，本书通过审视教育历史来质疑当今各国的教育实践。当今的教育体系源于十九世纪精英阶层控制潜在威胁人群的尝试，它是否是真正促进民主化、自由思考和有用知识增长的最佳途径？尽管这一问题仍然有效，但帕格莱安对支撑大众教育的历史因素的重新解读，与现有学术文献的部分内容并不完全吻合。本书的核心论点似乎隐含着一个假设，即教育主要是一种国家层面的现象，中央政府通过的国家教育法案在全国所有地区和社会阶层中产生了即时（且同质）的影响。事实上，用于衡量中央政府推动初等教育行动的最常用指标是是否通过了国家学校法。然而，最近的证据，特别是针对本书未涉及的国家，如意大利（卡佩利和瓦斯塔，2020年）和西班牙（贝尔特兰·塔皮亚和马丁内斯-加拉拉加，2018年），表明关于初等教育的国家立法本身可能无法有效促进教育发展，这主要是由于初等学校体系的设计方式，即主要采取分权模式。政府制定了游戏规则，但由地方当局执行（第108页）——其执行程度取决于地方民主化、财政和行政能力、不平等状况以及现有入学率等因素。帕格莱安声称行政形式（集权与分权）对其论点无关紧要（第118页），这一说法并不完全令人信服，尤其是考虑到欧洲已知的历史差异（韦斯特伯格，2020年）。另一个广泛关注的问题是在定量部分对混杂因素的处理。例如，入学率趋势的变化被解释为对社会动荡的回应（第79页），而其他替代解释——如经济表现或国家能力——则受到较少的关注。同样，尽管书中提到了战争（外部冲突），但其潜在的国家建设意义并未完全纳入分析框架。这可能存在问题，因为战争长期以来一直是财政能力扩张解释的核心（丁切科等人，2011年；萨巴特，2016年）。一个相关问题涉及用于捕捉可能与教育相关现象的结构性变化的某些变量。工业化使用宽泛指标来衡量（第66页），而教育的普及则通过国家教育立法的通过来代理——如前所述。有人可能会认为，这些衡量标准并不总能令人信服地捕捉潜在现象，特别是考虑到最近的研究表明渐进式、地方驱动的教育扩展的重要性（见上文），以及本书分析中涵盖的大多数国家现有的工业增加值或人均GDP估计数据。事实上，有人可能会认为，经济增长也可能通过服务业拉动教育扩展，甚至当新技术在初级部门引入时也是如此。本书的实证策略在某些情境下比其他情境更具说服力。对智利的分析，特别是阿塔卡马叛乱，作为一个引人注目的案例脱颖而出，其中清晰的核心-边缘冲突与理论高度契合。相比之下，来自欧洲的证据将受益于使用替代数据集进行复制。最近的研究，包括阿德里安·蒙塔尔博对十九世纪法国的研究，表明大众教育的扩展不仅仅是纪律渠道，还包括工业化促进的教育需求（蒙塔尔博，2020年）。对十九世纪英国以及不同情况下的瑞典和法国的讨论进一步说明了其中一些问题，并引发了其他问题。帕格莱安指出，大约在1850年，英国的入学率相对于欧洲大陆较低（第62-63页）。然而，就人力资本积累而言，识字率——无论其获取方式如何——可以说比正式入学更为重要。在这一指标上，英国并不显得特别落后。在十九世纪下半叶，英格兰和威尔士的识字率在欧洲各地区中最高（米奇，1984年），毛入学率也不比中欧和北欧落后多少（卡佩利、里多尔菲、瓦斯塔和韦斯特伯格，2025年）。本书还倾向于将城市和农村地区课程设置的差异解释为一种故意使农村人口固化的策略（第68页）。虽然这可能与本书的核心论点一致，但另一种解释是，简化的农村课程降低了入学门槛，使基础学校在资源和需求有限的地区得以扎根，这似乎是十九世纪瑞典的情况（韦斯特伯格，2022年）。法国案例也暴露了核心论点中的一些紧张关系。帕格莱安展示了精英阶层如何根据农村动荡在镇压和教育投资之间摇摆（第139页）。然而，早期初等教育本身涉及某种形式的强制，如强制入学、语言标准化和道德纪律，这些可能并未被视为与国家权力的其他工具根本不同。此外，教育回报的长期且不确定的时间跨度，使得从国家和地方精英的角度来看，教育是否明显优于镇压这一观点变得复杂。《被培养成服从》是一本重要且引人深思的书。它迫使历史学家和政治经济学家面对关于学校教育的政治目的以及教育与权力之间关系的令人不安的问题——可能为未来采用历史视角的实证研究留出空间。本书成功地拓宽了辩论范围，并挑战了将教育视为明确公共物品的自满叙事。它将被广泛阅读和讨论，这是理所当然的。
title: Raised to Obey: The Rise and Spread of Mass Education. Agustina Paglayan, (Princeton University Press, 2024. Pp. 384. ISBN 9780691261270 Pbk £28.)
title_zh: 《被培养为服从：大众教育的兴起与传播》

abstract: Abstract Demonstrating the existence of a soaring demand for strategic materials in fifteenth‐century Rome, the article pioneers research in the late medieval trade in saltpetre, the irreplaceable, rare component of gunpowder, indispensable for waging war following the diffusion of artillery technology. More importantly, the essay highlights the political measures undertaken to support the supply of materiel, revealing a pragmatic stance that combined state control with private initiative. The result is a compelling example of the role arms procurement played in the early development of state capacity.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文通过论证十五世纪罗马对战略物资需求的急剧增长，开创了对中世纪晚期硝石贸易的研究。硝石作为火药中不可或缺且稀有的成分，在火炮技术传播后成为战争不可或缺之物。更重要的是，本文着重探讨了为保障物资供应所采取的政治措施，揭示了一种结合国家控制与私人主动性的务实立场。这一案例有力地展示了军备采购在国家能力早期发展中所扮演的角色。
title: Strategic materials and state capacity in Renaissance Italy: The economic policies of ‘Roman saltpetre’ procurement
title_zh: 文艺复兴时期意大利的战略物资与国家能力：“罗马硝石”采购的经济政策

abstract: This paper brings together modern empirical techniques with contemporary high frequency data to fill two prominent gaps in the literature on Britain's interwar years: what were the quantitative effects of monetary policy on unemployment and prices in the years 1919–38, and how did that compare with the effects of fiscal policy? Its specific innovation is to draw on a previously little‐used weekly publication of public finance statistics, allowing the roles of monetary policy, taxation, and public spending to be assessed side‐by‐side in a coherent framework – a structural vector autoregression identified with sign restrictions. In a period of particularly unsettled policy, I find that policy shocks, both monetary and fiscal, made a material contribution to variation in prices and unemployment and played a central role in the two great recessions of the period, modern Britain's most severe. Other macroeconomic policy choices could have delivered better outcomes for prices and unemployment, but this would have required making different choices in the face of conflicting objectives and some sharp trade‐offs.
abstract_zh: 本文融合现代实证技术与当代高频数据，填补了英国两次世界大战之间时期文献中的两大空白：1919年至1938年间货币政策对失业和价格的量化影响，以及其与财政政策效果的比较。其独特创新在于利用一份先前鲜少使用的每周公共财政统计出版物，使得货币政策、税收和公共支出的作用得以在一个连贯框架内并排评估——即通过符号限制识别的结构向量自回归模型。在政策尤为动荡的时期，我发现政策冲击，无论是货币还是财政方面的，对价格和失业的变动做出了实质性贡献，并在该时期两次重大衰退中扮演了核心角色，这两次衰退是现代英国最严重的衰退。其他宏观经济政策选择本可为价格和失业带来更好的结果，但这将需要在面对相互冲突的目标和某些尖锐权衡时做出不同的选择。
title: Macroeconomic policymaking in interwar Britain: A reappraisal
title_zh: 两次世界大战期间英国的宏观经济政策制定：再评价

abstract: This article examines the gender wage gap and wage setting in the early cotton spinning factories of the industrial revolution, with a specific focus on Richard Arkwright's Lumford Mill in Bakewell, Derbyshire. The research links workers from the mill's wage books with parish baptism records to estimate ages and construct age–wage profiles in the spinning department. Findings show a significant gender wage gap emerging in adulthood, with women's wages stagnating while men advanced to higher‐paying roles such as overseers, indicating limited advancement for women. However, there is little evidence of gender wage discrimination among child workers. The gendered segmentation of the spinning workforce towards adulthood was the main cause of the wage gap. The analysis also reveals that weekly wage rates for children increased annually until adulthood. In rural mills such as Arkwright's, attracting labour was crucial. Yearly wage increases incentivized loyalty and ensured workforce stability, despite potential mismatches between wages and worker productivity.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了工业革命早期棉纺工厂中的性别工资差距与工资设定机制，重点关注位于德比郡贝克韦尔的理查德·阿克莱特朗姆福德工厂。研究将工厂工资簿中的工人记录与教区洗礼记录进行关联，以估算年龄并构建纺纱部门的年龄—工资曲线。研究发现，性别工资差距在成年期显著显现，女性工资停滞不前，而男性则晋升至监工等薪酬更高的职位，表明女性的晋升机会有限。然而，在童工中几乎没有发现性别工资歧视的证据。纺纱劳动力在成年期形成的性别分化是工资差距的主要原因。分析还显示，儿童的周工资率在成年之前逐年递增。在像阿克莱特这样的乡村工厂中，吸引劳动力至关重要。年度工资增长激励了忠诚度并确保了劳动力队伍的稳定，尽管工资与工人生产率之间可能存在不匹配。
title: Segmentation and gender wage disparities in the early industrial workforce: Insights from Arkwright's Lumford Mill, 1786–1811
title_zh: 早期工业劳动力中的分割与性别工资差异：基于阿克莱特朗福德磨坊（1786–1811）的洞察

abstract: This paper analyses a new large dataset of silver prices, as well as silver and merchandise trade flows in and out of China in the crucial decades of the mid‐nineteenth century when the Empire was opened to world trade. Silver flows were associated with the interaction between heterogeneous monetary preferences and availability of specific coins. Before the 1850s, money markets became increasingly efficient, as reliance on bills of exchange allowed exports to grow in times when sound money was in short supply. When a new standard for silver eventually emerged, there was a new peak in China's silver imports.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了一个关于白银价格的新大型数据集，以及19世纪中叶中国对外开放贸易的关键几十年间白银和商品贸易的进出流动。白银流动与不同货币偏好及特定硬币可得性之间的相互作用有关。在1850年代之前，货币市场日益高效，因为对汇票的依赖使得在硬通货短缺时期出口仍能增长。当白银最终确立新标准时，中国的白银进口达到了新的高峰。

title: China inside out: Explaining silver flows in the triangular trade, c. 1820s‒70s
title_zh: 内外中国：三角贸易中的白银流动解释（约1820年代至1870年代）

abstract: Abstract Whilst economic historians have invested substantial effort into understanding the economic consequences of religion, they have invested less effort into understanding the determinants of religious affiliation. The lack of knowledge about determinants of religious affiliation seems particularly striking in the case of Southeastern Europe. Populated by Catholics, Orthodox Christians, and Muslims, the region has been historically characterized by a high degree of religious diversity – an important determinant of comparative development patterns. This paper analyses one specific example of religious formation in Southeastern Europe – conversions to Islam in early modern Bosnia. Employing village‐level data from the Ottoman tax registers of 1468 and 1604, we find that settlements with lower income per household were more likely to convert to Islam. Given that premodern Bosnia was characterized by low agricultural yields, this finding implies that poverty induced peasants to convert to Islam. We hypothesize that the poll tax – a regressive tax removed upon conversion to Islam – stimulated the poorer Bosnians to adopt Islam upon the Ottoman conquest of their region.
abstract_zh: 摘要 尽管经济历史学家在理解宗教的经济后果方面投入了大量精力，但在理解宗教信仰的决定因素方面投入的精力较少。关于宗教信仰决定因素知识的缺乏，在东南欧的情况下显得尤为突出。该地区居住着天主教徒、东正教徒和穆斯林，历史上以高度的宗教多样性为特征——这是比较发展模式的一个重要决定因素。本文分析了东南欧宗教形成的一个具体例子——近代早期波斯尼亚的伊斯兰教皈依。利用1468年和1604年奥斯曼税收登记册中的村庄层面数据，我们发现人均收入较低的定居点更有可能皈依伊斯兰教。鉴于前现代波斯尼亚农业产量低下，这一发现意味着贫困促使农民皈依伊斯兰教。我们假设人头税——一种在皈依伊斯兰教后免除的累退税——在奥斯曼征服该地区后，刺激了较贫穷的波斯尼亚人采纳伊斯兰教。
title: Peasants into Muslims: Poverty and conversions to Islam in Ottoman Bosnia
title_zh: 从农民到穆斯林：奥斯曼波斯尼亚的贫困与伊斯兰皈依

abstract: A substantial body of literature has considered warfare a fundamental driver of fiscal capacity. We argue that the nature of the tax base available to governments can either foster or constrain the ability and incentives of central elites to impose their legitimacy once the war is over. We illustrate this dynamic by analysing the evolution of public revenues in Chile before, during, and after the War of the Pacific (1879–83). The seizure of natural resource‐rich areas enabled the Chilean state to raise public revenues and expand its size. This process was driven by a significant increase in natural resource revenues, accompanied by the reduction or decentralization of other revenue sources ‐ outcomes shaped by deliberate policy choices. Over time, the limitations of this arrangement became increasingly evident, paving the way for the introduction of new domestic taxes and investments in fiscal capacity from the early twentieth century onward. While these shifts are crucial for understanding the long‐term development of Chilean state capacity, they proved insufficient to address the short‐term macroeconomic vulnerabilities stemming from the state's dependence on natural resource taxation.
abstract_zh: 大量文献将战争视为财政能力的基本驱动因素。我们认为，政府可获得的税基性质，既能促进也可能制约中央精英在战后强加其合法性的能力与动机。我们通过分析太平洋战争（1879-83年）前后及期间智利公共收入的演变来阐释这一动态。对富含自然资源地区的占领使智利国家得以增加公共收入并扩大其规模。这一过程由自然资源收入的显著增长所推动，同时伴随着其他收入来源的减少或分散——这些结果是由深思熟虑的政策选择所塑造的。随着时间的推移，这一安排的局限性日益显现，为二十世纪初以来引入新的国内税收和财政能力投资铺平了道路。尽管这些转变对于理解智利国家能力的长期发展至关重要，但它们不足以解决因国家依赖自然资源税收而产生的短期宏观经济脆弱性。
title: The War of the Pacific and Chilean public revenues: Reallocation of the tax burden and institutional change
title_zh: 太平洋战争与智利公共收入：税负再分配与制度变迁

abstract: The reason for malaria's disappearance from northwestern Europe in the early twentieth century has long been discussed but remains an unresolved conundrum. This is partially due to a previous focus on the early modern era, and partially because various theories have never been tested against each other. In this study, we test some of the proposed hypotheses using nineteenth‐century Denmark as a case. We found that the accelerating agricultural improvements with drainage and increasing livestock per km 2 explained much of the declining incidence rates, whilst other factors such as household size, temperatures, and precipitation did not seem to matter. Increased drainage meant dryer surface environment, and this led to a reduced size of the mosquito populations and therefore fewer malaria infections, and increased access to livestock led to changes in the mosquitoes’ feeding preferences. Whilst drainage may have played a key role, it is possible that improvements in housing and clothing materials as well as use of quinine could also have affected malaria trends, although this could not be tested. We conclude that the disappearance of malaria was likely an unanticipated benefit of the agricultural developments related to the modernization of rural Denmark during the nineteenth century.
abstract_zh: 疟疾在二十世纪初从西北欧消失的原因长期以来一直备受讨论，但至今仍是一个未解之谜。这在一定程度上是因为以往的研究聚焦于近代早期，部分原因则是各种理论从未被相互检验过。在本研究中，我们以十九世纪的丹麦为案例，检验了一些提出的假说。我们发现，加速的农业改良，包括排水系统的改善和每平方公里牲畜数量的增加，在很大程度上解释了发病率的下降趋势，而其他因素如家庭规模、气温和降水量似乎并未产生影响。排水改善意味着地表环境更加干燥，这导致蚊虫种群数量减少，从而减少了疟疾感染；而牲畜可及性的增加则改变了蚊虫的吸血偏好。尽管排水可能起到了关键作用，但住房和衣物材料的改进以及奎宁的使用也可能影响了疟疾的趋势，尽管这一点无法得到验证。我们得出结论，疟疾的消失很可能是十九世纪丹麦农村现代化进程中农业发展所带来的意外益处。
title: The disappearance of malaria from Denmark, 1862–1900

abstract: This paper examines the distributive effects of personal income taxation in Sweden, the United Kingdom, and the United States during the first half of the twentieth century. We estimate the evolution of marginal and average effective tax rates across the income distribution and calculate the corresponding indices of progressivity and redistribution. Our results show that redistribution through income taxation increased during the period with varying intensity and mechanisms. During the First World War, this was a joint effect of increases in the amount of revenue collected and progressivity. In contrast, during the Second World War, revenue increased again, but progressivity diminished.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了二十世纪上半叶瑞典、英国和美国个人所得税的分配效应。我们估算了不同收入群体中边际及平均有效税率的演变，并计算了相应的累进性与再分配指数。结果显示，该时期内通过所得税实现的再分配有所增强，但力度与机制各异。第一次世界大战期间，这一变化源于税收收入规模与累进性的共同提升。相比之下，第二次世界大战期间，税收收入再次增加，但累进性有所减弱。
title: Income taxes and redistribution in the early twentieth century
title_zh: 20世纪初的所得税与再分配

abstract: We estimate the impact of reductions in poor law expenditure on rural life expectancy and mortality rates in England and Wales following the 1834 Poor Law Amendment Act. Given the scale of cuts imposed, our estimates imply 8–10 per cent increases in mortality at ages 1–4 years and 2–4 per cent falls in rural expectation of life at birth. This is consistent with the reformers’ policy of reducing child allowances for larger families. These results help to explain the weak performance of national mid‐nineteenth century life expectancy measures during a period of rising real wages but falling welfare expenditure.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了1834年《济贫法修正案》后，英格兰和威尔士地区济贫支出削减对农村预期寿命和死亡率的影响。鉴于削减幅度之大，我们的估计表明，1至4岁年龄段的死亡率上升了8%至10%，而农村出生时预期寿命下降了2%至4%。这与改革者对大家庭减少儿童补贴的政策相符。这些结果有助于解释19世纪中叶国家预期寿命指标表现疲弱的现象，这一时期实际工资上升但福利支出下降。
title: The new poor law and the health of the population of England and Wales
title_zh: 新济贫法与英格兰和威尔士人口健康

abstract: This article measures the cost of the early modern consumer revolution through a quantitative analysis of product and process innovations in Amsterdam and examines their variegated social impact in two distinct datasets of probate inventories. It demonstrates that middle‐class decencies became substantially cheaper during the seventeenth century, nuancing the industrious revolution hypothesis in urban settings, but we also find no sustained positive impact of rising consumption on the material living standards of the labouring masses. In the eighteenth century, in fact, first‐ and second‐hand prices diverged due to the combined effects of a supply glut, the accelerating turnover of fashion, and the inherent fragility of many novel consumer goods. While elite and middling households compensated for their indulgence in consumerism with prudent ‘investment’ in more durable possessions, thereby ensuring a transferable inheritance for the next generation, our analysis documents the material impoverishment of Amsterdam's working classes during the final decades of the ancien régime . The consumer revolution, we conclude, contributed to the eighteenth‐century rise of material – or ‘real’ – inequality between the shrinking middle classes of this preindustrial metropolis on the one hand and its growing numbers of impoverished inhabitants on the other.
abstract_zh: 本文通过定量分析阿姆斯特丹的产品与工艺创新，衡量了早期现代消费革命的成本，并利用两份不同的遗嘱财产清单数据集考察了其多样化的社会影响。研究表明，十七世纪中产阶级的体面生活成本大幅下降，这为城市环境中勤勉革命假说提供了细致化视角，但我们同样发现，消费增长对劳动大众的物质生活水平并未产生持续的正向影响。事实上，在十八世纪，由于供应过剩、时尚更迭加速以及许多新型消费品固有的易损性共同作用，一手与二手价格出现分化。尽管精英和中产家庭通过审慎“投资”于更耐久的财产来弥补其消费放纵，从而确保下一代可继承的遗产，我们的分析记录了旧制度最后几十年间阿姆斯特丹工人阶级的物质贫困化。我们得出结论，消费革命促成了十八世纪这座前工业大都市中，一方面日益缩小的中产阶级与另一方面不断增多的贫困居民之间物质——或“实际”——不平等的加剧。
title: The cost of the consumer revolution: Prices, material living standards, and real inequality in Amsterdam (1630‒1805)
title_zh: 消费者革命的代价：阿姆斯特丹的价格、物质生活水平与真实不平等（1630‒1805）

abstract: This article analyses wealth inequality in the Republic of Venice during 1400–1800. The availability of a large database of homogeneous inequality measurements allows us to produce the most in‐depth study of the factors affecting inequality at the local level available thus far for any preindustrial society. Additionally, the occurrence of a major plague during 1629–30, an event that caused the death of 40 per cent of the inhabitants of the area, allows us to contribute to the growing literature on the distributional consequences of epidemics. Across our dataset, of the three factors that recent literature has discussed as possibly able to explain overall inequality trends in the long run – economic development, population, and regressive taxation – regressive taxation set by the central state had a relatively strong impact. We also find that locally, differences in inequality levels were determined by closeness to the capital city of Venice, altitude, and suitability of land to specific crops. Regarding the impact of the plague, we demonstrate that whilst the 1630 plague was different from the medieval Black Death as it did not lead to large‐scale and enduring levelling, it did cause a structural break in the way in which some key variables affected inequality.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了1400年至1800年间威尼斯共和国的财富不平等状况。利用一个包含大量同质不平等测量数据的大型数据库，我们得以对影响地方层面不平等的因素进行迄今为止最深入的研究，这一研究深度在工业化前社会中尚属首次。此外，1629-30年间爆发的一场大瘟疫，导致该地区40%居民死亡，这一事件使我们能够为关于流行病分配后果的日益增长的文献做出贡献。在我们的数据集中，近期文献讨论的可能长期解释整体不平等趋势的三个因素——经济发展、人口和累退税制——中，中央政权设定的累退税制影响相对较强。我们还发现，在地方层面，不平等水平的差异取决于与威尼斯首都的接近程度、海拔高度以及土地对特定作物的适宜性。关于瘟疫的影响，我们证明，尽管1630年的瘟疫与中世纪的黑死病不同，它并未导致大规模且持久的均等化，但它确实在关键变量影响不平等的方式上造成了结构性断裂。
title: Wealth inequality and epidemics in the Republic of Venice (1400–1800)
title_zh: 威尼斯共和国的财富不平等与流行病（1400–1800）

abstract: Abstract Exploiting quasi‐exogenous variations in the timing of telegraph construction, the reduction of information costs promotes capital market integration in late imperial China. Employing a difference‐in‐differences strategy, we find that telegraph connection within a prefecture pair reduced the difference in interest rate by 1.27 percentage points. Institutional quality and transportation accessibility complemented telegraph's role in enhancing capital market integration. In addition, financial intermediaries augmented the telegraph's effect on capital market integration. For the traditional banks ( piaohao ), the augmenting effect was only salient within firm boundaries, suggesting that information was only exchanged within firm‐specific networks.
abstract_zh: 摘要 利用电报建设时间上的准外生变化，信息成本的降低促进了晚清中国的资本市场一体化。采用双重差分策略，我们发现府际电报连接使利率差异降低了1.27个百分点。制度质量与交通可达性对电报在增强资本市场一体化中的作用具有互补效应。此外，金融中介放大了电报对资本市场一体化的影响。对于传统票号而言，这种放大效应仅在企业边界内显著，表明信息仅在特定企业网络内部交换。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Telegraph and capital market integration: Evidence from late imperial China
title_zh: 电报与资本市场一体化：来自晚清中国的证据

abstract: This study examines the impact of Italy's 1887–8 health reforms on mortality, contributing to the historical debate on the state's role in Europe's health transition. Leveraging event‐study‐style difference‐in‐differences approach, we assess the effectiveness of the Crispi–Pagliani reforms, which strengthened public health governance and introduced targeted non‐pharmaceutical interventions to mitigate deaths from infectious diseases. Mortality from targeted diseases decreased by 8.5 per cent relative to non‐targeted diseases within 5 years of the reforms. The results highlight the role of sanitary surveillance and coordinated governance, particularly effective in less‐educated regions, where public authorities compensated for limited health knowledge and prompted information flow in a broader process of top‐down modernization.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了意大利1887-1888年卫生改革对死亡率的影响，为关于国家在欧洲健康转型中作用的历史辩论提供了新证据。采用事件研究式双重差分法，我们评估了克里斯皮-帕利亚尼改革的有效性，该改革强化了公共卫生治理，并引入了针对性的非药物干预措施以降低传染病死亡率。改革实施后五年内，目标疾病的死亡率相对于非目标疾病下降了8.5%。研究结果凸显了卫生监督与协调治理的作用，尤其在教育水平较低地区效果显著，在这些地区，公共当局弥补了健康知识的不足，并在自上而下的现代化进程中促进了信息流动。
title: Public health reforms and the mortality decline in nineteenth‐century Italy
title_zh: 19世纪意大利公共卫生改革与死亡率下降

abstract: We study the procurement patterns of non-listed firms and examine how these often-overlooked, yet pivotal players in global supply chains adjust their sourcing when they anticipate accountability for externalities beyond their organizational boundaries. Using granular customs data and a surprise information release about the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act, product-level regressions reveal that importing firms are 3.5 percentage points less likely to source a product from countries where the relevant production sector exhibits elevated ESG-related risks, suggesting that firms tend to cut ties with higher-risk suppliers. The effects are concentrated among firms with well-diversified supplier networks for a product and higher profitability, suggesting they have the necessary flexibility to respond quickly to anticipated regulatory pressure. Our findings suggest that mandates requiring firms to incorporate broad sustainability considerations into their operational decisions may have limits, particularly for non-listed firms.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了非上市企业的采购模式，并考察了这些在全球供应链中常被忽视却至关重要的参与者，在预期需为其组织边界之外的外部性承担责任时，如何调整其采购来源。利用细粒度海关数据及关于德国《供应链尽职调查法》的意外信息披露，产品层面的回归分析显示，进口企业从相关生产部门存在较高ESG相关风险的国家采购某产品的可能性降低了3.5个百分点，这表明企业倾向于切断与高风险供应商的联系。这一效应集中在拥有产品供应商网络多元化程度较高且盈利能力较强的企业中，暗示这些企业具备必要的灵活性，能够迅速响应预期的监管压力。我们的研究结果表明，要求企业将广泛的可持续性考量纳入运营决策的强制性规定可能存在局限性，尤其对非上市企业而言。
title: The limits of local laws in global supply chains: Cutting ties or “edutrading” procurement partners?
title_zh: 全球供应链中地方法律的局限性：切断联系还是“教育型交易”采购伙伴？

abstract: We test whether forecast bias affects household stock trading by combining measures of bias elicited in laboratory experiments with administrative trade-level data. On average, subjects exhibit positive forecast bias (i.e., extrapolators), while a large minority exhibit negative forecast bias (i.e., contrarians). Forecast bias is positively associated with past excess returns of stocks that are purchased: Extrapolators (contrarians) purchase past winners (losers). Forecast bias is negatively associated with the capital gains of stocks that are sold. Furthermore, forecast bias explains investor heterogeneity in the relation between market returns and net flows to stocks. Overall, our study provides evidence of a common mechanism – forecast bias – that links past returns to trading decisions for purchases, sales, and net flows.
abstract_zh: 我们通过将实验室实验中引发的偏差度量与行政级别的交易数据相结合，检验预测偏差是否影响家庭股票交易。平均而言，受试者表现出正向预测偏差（即外推者），而相当一部分少数群体表现出负向预测偏差（即反向投资者）。预测偏差与所购股票过去的超额收益正相关：外推者（反向投资者）购买过去的赢家（输家）。预测偏差与所售股票的资本利得负相关。此外，预测偏差解释了投资者在市场回报与股票净流入之间关系上的异质性。总体而言，我们的研究提供了证据表明存在一种共同机制——预测偏差——它将过去的回报与购买、出售及净流入的交易决策联系起来。
title: Extrapolators and contrarians: Forecast bias and individual investor stock trading
title_zh: 外推者与反向投资者：预测偏差与个人投资者股票交易

abstract: This study examines the effect of Department of Justice lawsuits in the 2010s against large lenders for alleged fraud in the Federal Housing Administration (FHA) mortgage insurance program. The suits led to over $5 billion in settlements and caused targeted banks and their peers to precipitously exit the FHA market. Difference-in-differences and triple-differences tests exploiting geographic variation in exposure to exiting banks show an 18% reduction in FHA lending in heavily exposed areas. This reduction was not associated with improved underwriting standards or lower default rates. Large banks’ FHA exit has significantly reduced low-income households’ overall access to mortgage credit.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了2010年代美国司法部针对大型贷款机构在联邦住房管理局（FHA）抵押贷款保险项目中涉嫌欺诈提起的诉讼所产生的影响。这些诉讼导致了超过50亿美元的和解金，并促使目标银行及其同行迅速退出FHA市场。利用暴露于退出银行的地理差异进行的双重差分和三重差分检验显示，在高度暴露地区，FHA贷款减少了18%。这一减少并未与承保标准的改善或违约率的下降相关联。大型银行退出FHA市场显著降低了低收入家庭整体获得抵押贷款信贷的机会。
title: Government litigation risk and the decline in low-income mortgage lending
title_zh: 政府诉讼风险与低收入群体抵押贷款发放的减少
